submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 4 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation performance at 10 GeV/c with a separation of 4.589 sigma. This represents a 32.6% improvement over Radiator-R1 (best: 3.46 sigma at 1 cm) and a 58.5% improvement over Radiator-R2 (best: 2.895 sigma at 4 cm). All three radiators pass the transparency constraint (≤10% loss after 10-year humidity ageing), but R3 delivers substantially superior particle identification capability. The recommended 4 cm thickness is well within the allowed range (1-6 cm) and represents the optimal point for R3 where separation performance peaks before degradation occurs at greater thicknesses.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 at 4 cm achieves 4.589 sigma separation, which is the highest among all radiator-thickness combinations tested. This is 32.6% better than the best R1 configuration and 58.5% better than the best R2 configuration.
